died.name: Victims of the Erfurt latrine disaster
died.cause: While Henry VI, the King of Germany, was holding an informal assembly at the Petersburg Citadel in Erfurt, the combined weight of the assembled nobles caused the wooden second storey floor of the building to collapse. Most of the nobles fell through into the latrine cesspit below the ground floor, where about 60 of them drowned in liquid excrement.

died.name: Atahualpa
died.desc: last Sapa Inca of the Inca Empire
died.last_words: What have I done, or my children, that I should meet such a fate? And from your hands, too, you who have met with friendship and kindness from my people who have received nothing but benefits from my hands.

died.name: John Wilmot, 2nd Earl of Rochester
died.last_words: The only objection against the Bible is a bad life.

died.name: Ulrica Eleanor the Elder
died.last_words: Yes, like that, just like that, my royal friend, raise me upward, upward!

died.name: Georg Wilhelm Richmann
died.cause: built an apparatus to study electricity from lightning. While "trying to quantify the response of an insulated rod to a nearby storm," it produced a ball of lightning that struck him in the forehead and killed him.

died.name: William Romaine
died.desc: evangelical divine of the Church of England
died.last_words: Holy, holy, holy, blessed Lord Jesus! to Thee be endless praise!

died.name: Sam Houston
died.cause: to his wife, Margaret Lea Houston

died.name: James A. Mulligan
died.desc: Union Army colonel of the American Civil War
died.cause: mortally wounded at the Second Battle of Kernstown
died.last_words: Lay me down, and save the flag!

died.name: Fred Duesenberg
died.cause: killed in a high-speed road accident in a Duesenberg automobile.

died.name: Winsor McCay
died.cause: to his wife after he found that his right arm was paralyzed
died.last_words: It's gone, mother! Gone, gone, gone!

died.name: Iven Carl Kincheloe Jr.
died.cause: final radio transmission prior to failed ejection from Lockheed F-104A
died.last_words: Edwards, Mayday seven seven two-bailing out.

born.name: John Field
born.last_words: Thank you-but don't kiss me; it is the sweat of death. I am dying, and it's for the best.

born.name: George Bernard Shaw
born.last_words: Sister, you're trying to keep me alive as an old curiosity, but I'm done, I'm finished, I'm going to die.

born.name: Charles Becker
born.cause: prior to execution by electrocution for murder
born.last_words: Oh, Lord, I proclaim to the world that I am innocent of this crime.

born.name: Carl Jung
born.last_words: Let's have a really good red wine tonight.

born.name: Aldous Huxley
born.cause: to his wife Laura ("im" being an abbreviation for intramuscular)

born.name: Gracie Allen
born.last_words: I'm sorry, boys, I'm all wet.
